template.description: The resource name of the tag template that this tag uses. Example: projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/tagTemplates/{tagTemplateId} This field cannot be modified after creation.
template.rationale: This is a user-defined resource reference and does not by itself control access to the underlying resource or data.

fields.description: This maps the ID of a tag field to the value of and additional information about that field. Valid field IDs are defined by the tag's template. A tag must have at least 1 field and at most 500 fields. Structure is [documented below](#nested_fields).
fields.rationale: This block defines metadata fields and values for cataloging, but it does not directly control access to data.

field_name.description: The identifier for this object. Format specified above.
field_name.rationale: This is a user-defined identifier and does not control access to the resource or data.

display_name.description: (Output) The display name of this field
display_name.rationale: This is only a human-readable display name and does not control access to the resource or data.

order.description: (Output) The order of this field with respect to other fields in this tag. For example, a higher value can indicate a more important field. The value can be negative. Multiple fields can have the same order, and field orders within a tag do not have to be sequential.
order.rationale: This controls display or ordering behavior and does not affect resource security.

double_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with double type.
double_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

string_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with string type.
string_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

bool_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with boolean type.
bool_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

timestamp_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with timestamp type.
timestamp_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

enum_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with enum type. This value must be one of the allowed values in the definition of this enum.
enum_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

column.description: Resources like Entry can have schemas associated with them. This scope allows users to attach tags to an individual column based on that schema. For attaching a tag to a nested column, use `.` to separate the column names. Example: `outer_column.inner_column`
column.rationale: This is a user-defined column reference for metadata tagging and does not control access to the column data.

parent.description: The name of the parent this tag is attached to. This can be the name of an entry or an entry group. If an entry group, the tag will be attached to all entries in that group.
parent.rationale: This is a user-defined resource reference and does not by itself control access to the underlying resource or data.
